description: This is a test class for the EmailSubscriberDao component in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing CRUD operations and retrieval functionalities of email subscriber data within the admin DAO layer.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for the EmailSubscriberDao class, verifying methods for retrieving, saving, editing, and deleting email subscriber records within the Human Resource Management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by creating an instance of EmailSubscriberDao and populating test data from YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmailSubscribersList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of email subscribers list based on a specific email subscription ID using filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetEmailSubscriberById
methods.description: Checks fetching a single email subscriber by ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSaveEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new email subscriber and verifies persisted data.

methods.name: testEditEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Tests updating an existing email subscriber and verifies the changes.

methods.name: testDeleteSubscriber
methods.description: Verifies deletion of email subscribers by IDs.
